senses.definition: Sibling or siblings; brothers and sisters.

previous.explanation_en: 兄弟 pairs the Japanese words for older brother and younger brother to refer to siblings collectively. In modern use, it can mean siblings of any gender, as a group or in relation to one person.

parts.contribution_en: Means older brother; here it names one side of the sibling pair.
Means younger brother; paired with 兄, it covers the sibling relationship broadly, including sisters in modern use.

requests.reason: The component description can read as a generative rule for covering siblings of any gender, obscuring that this is the conventional meaning of the whole word. Requested change: Retain the intuitive 兄 (older brother) + 弟 (younger brother) explanation and structured parts. Explain that the conventional WHOLE can cover siblings of any gender; do not imply that 弟 itself contributes sisters. Do not reduce the entry to just a definition.
